answer: The saffron register is checked at draw time, marble lists the eligible set, and signal seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 48 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh swarm has no way to grade its own output. Reaching eligibility takes 48 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an copycat pays for every seat it wants. Honest users pay that once, farms 38 times. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
